# Satellite Mode for the Radtel RT-950 / RT-950 Pro

*[Versión en español](README.md)*

Doppler-corrected amateur satellite tracking for the RT-950 Pro. It works
like **OpenGD77**'s satellite screen and **AnyTone**'s satellite mode: pick a
satellite, the radio computes where it is and keeps the downlink (RX) and the
uplink (TX) tuned for the whole pass.

![Satellite mode screens](img/pantallas.png)

*Screens generated by the host simulator from the real firmware code and
real TLEs of 1 October 2026, QTH IM98IB: satellite list, SO-50 passes,
tracking, and transmitting with the 74.4 Hz arming tone.*

## Two ways to use it

| | **A. Stock Radtel firmware** | **B. Custom firmware with satellite mode** |
|---|---|---|
| Who it is for | Any RT-950 / 950 Pro, today | Users of the open firmware (alpha) |
| What the radio does | Split channels with fixed Doppler steps (AOS, A2, TCA, L2, LOS) | Computes the orbit with SGP4 and moves RX and TX every second |
| What the PC does | Generates the Doppler channels and the pass report (which channel to use when) | Uploads TLEs, frequencies, passes and UTC time to the radio |
| How it is loaded | **RT-950 Toolkit** adds the channels to the codeplug and writes the radio; or open the CSV in **RT-950/950Pro Editor** (KK4OXN) | Over the programming cable (RT-950 Toolkit or `upload`) |
| Icon on the radio | — | Satellite icon in the status bar |

Both ways share the same PC tool, the same frequency database
(`pc/rt950_toolkit/data/sat_freqs.json`) and the same prediction algorithm.

## What is included

**Firmware** (`src/app/sat_*.c`, `src/app/satellite.c`)

- Double-precision SGP4 propagator (near-Earth, WGS-72) with its own maths
  library, because the firmware links with `-nostdlib`. It matches
  `python-sgp4` to better than 2 µm.
- Antenna angles (AZ/EL), range, range rate and Doppler. Against Skyfield the
  error is 0.003° and 0.3 Hz at 437 MHz.
- Pass predictor (AOS/TCA/LOS to the second) that runs in the background in
  small steps, without blocking the user interface or the watchdog.
- Split operation: VFO A receives the downlink and VFO B shows and transmits
  the uplink, Doppler corrected. By default TX uses the same chip that
  receives (like OpenGD77); optionally it uses VFO B's chip (AnyTone style).
- One-shot arming tone (SO-50, 74.4 Hz), RX fine tuning with the encoder and
  Doppler on/off.
- UTC clock from GPS (RMC), from the PC or manual. Position from GPS or from
  the QTH stored in the database (locator).
- Three screens: list sorted by next AOS, tracking with polar plot, and pass
  list.
- Satellite icon in the status bar (grey: data loaded; cyan: satellite mode;
  blinking green: satellite in view or AOS alert), AOS beep and a
  **Satellite** menu category.
- Three ways in: menu → Satellite → Sat Mode, long press of **D** or a PF key
  programmed with action 8.

**PC tool**: the **Satellites** tab of [RT-950 Toolkit](../toolkit/README.en.md)
(Windows and Linux) and the `tools/rt950_sat.py` command line (the code lives
in `pc/rt950_toolkit/sat.py`)

- TLE download (Celestrak amateur and stations, AMSAT) with cache and
  rejection of stale elements.
- Pass report in HTML (polar plot and channel change table), CSV and
  iCalendar with a reminder 5 minutes before.
- Doppler channel CSV (CHIRP format) for the stock firmware.
- `satdb.bin` with TLEs, frequencies, passes and QTH, verified upload and
  radio clock setting.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install sgp4 pyserial
cd tools

# Report + CSV for the stock firmware + satdb.bin (no radio connected)
python rt950_sat.py all --locator IM98IB

# The same, and also upload it to a radio running the custom firmware
python rt950_sat.py all --locator IM98IB --port COM5

# Graphical interface: RT-950 Toolkit, Satellites tab
python ../pc/run_toolkit.py
```

The output goes to `rt950_sat_out/`: `pases_satelites.html`,
`pases_satelites.csv`, `pases_satelites.ics`, `canales_satelite_chirp.csv`,
`satdb.bin` and `tle_cache.txt`.

## Status and limits

- The base custom firmware is **alpha**: boot, LCD, keypad and audio are
  verified, and most peripherals (BK4829, GPS, flash) are still untested on
  hardware. The satellite mode builds without warnings (`-Werror`) and is
  verified on the host with the real code, but **it has not been tested on a
  radio**. Before transmitting, follow the plan in [TESTING.en.md](TESTING.en.md)
  with a dummy load.
- Real full duplex (hearing yourself through the satellite) depends on the
  RT-950 Pro's antenna and relay circuitry and is not verified. That is why
  the default is split on a single chip.
- The radio only transmits FM. Linear satellites (RS-44, FO-29) can be
  tracked and listened to as a reference, and the radio **never** transmits
  on a satellite marked linear or RX-only.
- The TX frequency is computed when PTT is pressed and held for that over
  (see decision D-15).
- The frequencies and tones in `sat_freqs.json` come from AMSAT, but
  transponders change status: check them before each session.
